set.body: Implement scoped bounded progress channels with transaction-owned UI reservations, all delivery policies, graceful close/cancel and producer wakeup; optional real Scala-created worker adapter sharing current scheduling/acceptance; owner-pumped completion delivery. Add independent transport oracle, JVM/Native pressure and retirement tests, runnable public-API async workbench with ScalaFX authoring comparison, fresh-context review and qualification receipts. Preserve concurrent graphics/text/Unicode work. Foreign C producers and interactive desktop hosting remain separate.
set.title: C1.6a bounded progress transport, real workers and workbench specimen
